articles.summary: The Indian Parliament passed the MSMED Amendment Bill 2026 to strengthen the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) framework. The bill focuses on improving delayed payment mechanisms, expanding the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS), enhancing the Micro and Small Enterprise Facilitation Councils (MSEFCs), streamlining Udyam registration, and easing business operations. This legislative action aims to boost the ease of doing business for MSMEs in India.

articles.title: July 2026: Rivers Crossing Highest Flood Levels
articles.summary: The Dikhow river crossed its highest flood level (HFL) at the upstream Bihubar site in July 2026, a first in 28 years. Downstream at Sivasagar, the river has frequently crossed HFL since August 2018. Both sites are long-established monitoring points where previous HFLs were recorded in June 1998. The repeated flooding may signal worsening climate impacts requiring policy attention.
articles.raw_summary: The Dikhow river crossed its HFL at the upstream Bihubar site for the first time in 28 years. However, at the downstream Sivasagar site, the river has been crossing the HFL frequently by small margins since Aug. 2018. Both are long established monitoring sites, where the previous HFLs were recorded on June 24 and June 25, 1998, respectively.
